card.name: Words leading into suicide or crime risk
card.fires_on: The word right after a risk or link phrase, such as "risk of" or "relation between ... and", where a harm outcome comes next, mainly "suicidal" or "criminal".

modes.label: Suicidal after risk
modes.description: The word "suicidal" following "risk of" or "risk factor for" in antidepressant or antiepileptic warnings.
modes.example: depression itself is a risk factor for<< suicidal>> thoughts and behaviors.

modes.label: Crime and mental disorder links
modes.description: Words in research text linking mental disorders in youth to offending.
modes.example: during adolescence and<< criminal>> behavior when those youth became adults.2

modes.label: Linking words before outcomes
modes.description: Small linking words or punctuation before an adverse outcome.
modes.example: is associated<< with>> poor pregnancy outcomes.

card.writes: It seems to push toward harm-outcome wording such as victim, with little else clear.
card.plain: It lights up on the word just before a bad outcome, such as suicidal thoughts or criminal behavior, is named.
